name: registry
description: Capability Registry: discover, validate, list, and health-check module manifests across modules/

capabilities.name: registry.discovery
capabilities.description: Scan modules/*/manifest.json, validate against the schema, and return normalized CapabilityManifest objects (discovery.py, schema.py)

capabilities.name: registry.health
capabilities.description: Execute declared health_checks via subprocess and aggregate healthy/degraded/unhealthy status with credential presence checks (health.py)

health_checks.description: Verify registry CLI discovers and lists modules

storage.description: No persistent storage; manifests are read on demand from modules/*/manifest.json
